events.title: Pacific Makers Market
events.summary: 3rd annual outdoor market at The Pacific motel; local handmade goods, jewelry, home décor, live music, food & drinks. Free entry.

events.title: Shoreline Inn Holiday Light Display
events.summary: 25,000+ twinkling lights decorate the Shoreline Inn nightly 6–11:30 pm from Thanksgiving through Jan 6. Free to view.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting
events.venue: Corner of Ocean Ave & D Street, Cayucos
events.summary: Community Christmas tree lighting with carolers, Santa & Mrs. Claus arriving by fire engine, and holiday cheer. Free event.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Wonderland Walk
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce / Cayucos Lioness Club
events.summary: Holiday stroll on Ocean Ave with snow play, Santa photos, free horse-drawn wagon rides, kids' craft workshop & merchants open house.
